name: Do As ~Shinpu-sama no Iinari~
original_name: ドゥアズ～神父様ノ言いなり～
source:
The protagonist has never had much faith, but he studied theology at a large church and became a priest. He holds a good outward appearance, but in reality, he's just a scumbag.

He was supposed to be assigned to a big city, where he could lead a glamorous life behind the scenes, but out of the blue, he was sent to a boring church in the countryside. He was in despair after reluctantly making his way to the countryside, but when he saw the beautiful sister who greeted him, he felt an instant surge of motivation and arousal.

The pure-hearted sister, who never doubts the goodness of people, is fooled by the protagonist, who pretends to think seriously about the countryside, and soon looks at him with admiration. Naturally, the protagonist sets his sights on the vulnerable and naive sister.

"I couldn't do this job without at least a few perks..."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角从来没有太多的信仰，但他在一座大教堂学习神学并成为一名牧师。他的外表很好，但实际上他只是个渣男。

本该被分配到一座大城市，在那里他可以在幕后过上光鲜亮丽的生活，却出乎意料地被分配到了乡村一座无聊的教堂。无奈的来到乡下，他本来很绝望，但当他看到迎面而来的美丽姐姐时，他瞬间就有了动力和兴奋。

心地纯洁、从不怀疑人性善良的姐姐，被假装认真思考乡村的主角所愚弄，很快就用钦佩的目光看着他。主角自然而然地将目光投向了脆弱而天真的妹妹。

“如果没有一些额外的福利，我就无法完成这份工作……”

[翻译自[url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/]官网[/url]]
